english: (I can't sleep...)
(Hm? Who's up at this hour?)
Okay.\nTiptoe, careful steps... hehe.
Without waking Miku,\nI'd sneak out like this -\nreminds me of those days.
Who knew that experience would come in handy here...\n!
Was that... Hibiki?\nWhere's she going at this hour?\nI'm curious...
(This is...!!)
Haaaaah!!\nTaoh! Sei! Teryaaa!!
One more!\nUoooooh!! Ataah!
(Secret training this late at night?\nAnd so intense!)
Fuuuh...
Hmm, it still doesn't click.\nI want more of a GRAB and BAM,\nthen GYUN! GWA! y'know?
Hm? Who's there?
It's... me.
A ghost!\nOr maybe a monster!?\nNo questions asked - first strike!
Wah, w-wait!\nIt's me!
...Meow, meow.
Oh, it's just a kitty.
Wait, no cat sounds that gruff!\nWho is it!?
Whoa!?
Oh, it's you.\nWhat are you doing out here at night?
No, if you don't wanna say, that's fine.\nI'll pretend I didn't see you.
But go home and sleep soon!\nYou'll get sick.
Says you...\nWeren't you doing some intense exercise?
I-I wasn't doing anything!\nJust some before-bed calisthenics.
I can't fall asleep unless I move around a little before bed...\nhehe.
See, like this!\nOne, two! Three, four!\nCome on, with me!
Uh, I'll pass on the 'with me'...
...\nA-anyway, please keep this between us!
Well, I'm heading back first!\nGood night!
That looked like full-intensity training...\nis that 'calisthenics' to Hibiki???
Stealthy, stealthy...
Um, are you awake?
(I'm awake, but... I'll pretend to be asleep...)
With Miku I'd just tickle-fight here,\nbut I can't do that with you, so...
I'll settle for pinching your nose!
(You can tell from THAT!?\nWait, she's actually doing it!?)
...Oh, looks asleep.\nOff I go!
(I almost fell asleep for real...\nBut where's she going this late? Should I follow her?)
H-huh? Did I lose her...
Gotcha!
You'd be dead in a real fight... just kidding!
D-don't scare me like that...
You were actually awake.\nYou totally fooled me.\nMan, I still need more trainingg.
Were you looking for me, by any chance?
I was wondering about you\nsneaking out at night...
Ah, you knew after all.\nI wanted to keep it secret,\nbut no helping it now.
Training?
Yes, exactly!\nTo better myself -\nI'm training my body!
Before-bed calisthenics, was it?
Huh... wait?\nYou really don't get it?
Training!\nIt's training!\nTo better myself - I'm training my body!
You train a lot during the day too, right?\nWith Aria and the others.
Yes!\nBut that's not enough, so I started doing it secretly at night too.
It's not just Noise -\nI might have to fight enemies I don't even know!\nI have to train harder and harder!
But is that okay?\nCutting sleep like that - isn't that overworking?
I knew you'd worry...\nThat's why I was doing it secretly.\nI don't want everyone to worry.
But I'm fine!\nA little tiredness\nis nothing!
My body's a little different\nfrom a normal person's, y'know.
Is that so?
Of course, after serious training\nI'm totally wiped -\nall floppy and melty.
Training IS tough!\nBut the great part is\nit's not just tiring.
My master said\nthere's something you can only see\nby going to your limit.
Plus, a good meal fixes me right up!\nWell, one more round -\nhere I go!
Oh, I almost forgot!\nCan you keep this\nfrom everyone?
I wanna power up in secret and surprise everyone!\n...\nAnd I don't want them to worry.
I see... Understood.
It's our secret!\nSee ya!
She really is a hard worker...
Sei! Yaa!! Taa!!\nDeeei!!
(She's at it, she's at it...)
...Fuu. Time for a breather!
Ah!\nWhat's up?
I brought some water...
Waha, thanks!\nI was just getting thirsty!
Hydration is a must when exercising!\nI've even nearly collapsed from forgetting,\nhehe.
Well, I'm on break,\nso let's chat!
Nn, nn, nn...!
Puhah!\nNothing beats this going down\nafter working up a sweat!
That training was intense.\nOn top of fighting and daytime training -\nisn't it too much?
It's not that it's not hard,\nbut it doesn't bother me.
Something happened\nthat made me feel that way, though.
Something?
Someone saved my life,\nand I inherited their power -\nI became a Symphogear wielder.
So with this saved life and inherited power,\nI wanted to help people.
I don't have any talents to brag about,\nso I figured I could at least help everyone\nwith what I can do.
But I was naive.
I didn't understand what fighting meant at all,\nand because of that I made Tsubasa sad...\nI hurt her.
Hibiki...
But I have things I want to protect too.\nAn ordinary day - laughing and eating together,\nand laughing and eating again tomorrow...
Tsubasa understood my resolve to protect that,\nand the feelings in my heart.
So without hesitation,\nI'll help everyone with all my strength.\nThat's what I want to do.
But right now I'm not at my full strength.\nSo I have to train more and more,\nand get stronger!
(She really is straightforward...\nAnd she's still not at full strength?\nJust how strong is Hibiki?)
Ahaha, did I sound\na little too cool just now?
But what about you?\nDon't you want to get stronger\nand protect someone?
Y-yeah,\nI do want to be useful to everyone, but...
That's the answer I was waiting for!\nThen let's train together sometime!
Huh? Me too?
Two people get more into it than one.\nYou'll see\nonce you try!
In that case...\nI'll do my best, in my own way.
That's the spirit!\nDon't worry, I'll be gentle!
But someone like me...
What matters is your fighting spirit!\nThe will to get stronger -\nwith that, results follow!
...Understood.\nI'll do my best, in my own way.
Let's do this!\nAlright, I'm fired up!!
Break's over! One more round!\nLet's go go go!!
(Can I even keep up...?)
Eisaah!!
Oh, you came!\nI've been waiting!
I've been looking forward to today's training!\nLet's do this!
G-go easy on me...
There's so much we could do,\nit's hard to pick where to start...
First, the most basic of basics!\nHow about we start with running!
Ahaha, you've got\n'I thought it'd be tougher' written all over your face!
I'm not such a demon\nI'd throw you into hell-training right away.\nAlright, let's go!
Hoh, hoh...
You're faster than I expected!
Running away is my specialty...
I can't lose either!\nAlright, it's a race!
Whoa, fast!?
Haa, haa...
Kuhaa, I'm beat!\nIt's been ages since I ran this much.
Heh, heh...\nS-sorry, I pooped out first...
I pushed the pace too much...\nBut it'll build stamina!
And... how about it?\nIsn't it getting fun?
Yeah, maybe it is...\nWay more fun than running from enemies.
Ahaha, right!
I'm too tired for that.
I seee.\nWell, soon you'll handle this much\nno problem!
Still, you're amazing, Hibiki.\nI've got no stamina or guts, as you can see.
I know how you feel.\nI was like that at first too.
But what matters\nis the will to keep at it!
Do that, and results\nfollow!
Haa, but I had fun today!\nI'm usually alone,\nso honestly it gets a little lonely.
...That's right!\nSince we're at it, want to keep going a little more?\nNext, forms practice!
Ei! Yaa! That stuff!\nIt really pumps you up!\nFills you with fighting spirit!
...Understood.\nI'll try!
Yay!\nI'm looking forward to it!
(Her enthusiasm won me over and I agreed!\nB-but can I even do it...?)
(But this might not be so bad...)
Let's go! Ooh!!
Osu! Let's do this!
No need to be so tense.\nIt's just forms practice -\nwe're not actually trading punches!
But! Fair warning:\nmy master's teaching was super strict,\nso I'll probably be strict too!
(...Gulp.)
First...\ncall me Master!
Huh?\nWhy?\n'Cause they say everything starts with form!
That stuff affects training too!\nIt's not just 'cause I want to hear it -\nokay?
Anyway, say it!\nCome on! Come on, come on!
...Master.
Noo, louder!\nFrom the bottom of your belly!
Master!!
There it is!!\nKuu... 'Master'!\nWhat a beautiful ring to it!
Oops... well done!\nProjection matters!
(Is she... happy...?)
First, 100 push-ups!\nThen sit-ups, back extensions! Squats!\n100 each!
Huh?\nThat's just the warm-up.\nYou gotta be able to breeze through this much!
I'll do it with you!\nAlright, begin!
Toh!
Put your hips into it!
Dah!
Noo, not like that!\nWatch my movements closely!
Hoooh...\nOryaaa!!
(Sh-she blew away that huge tree...!)
Fuu... See?
Take in the lightning,\nand strike like you're crushing thunder in your fist!\nThat's it!
I don't understand a word of that!
If you don't get it, feel it!\nCome on, try it!
Toah!
Hoah!!
Tah!
Atchaah!!
Good work!\n...Wait, are you okay!?
Haha, stomach all twisted?\nSame for me.\nThey call that sweating from your stomach.
This... is an experience I won't forget.
But it's not just exhaustion, right?\nDon't you feel something welling up?
Hehe,\nwhat do you think that feeling is?
Is this... fulfillment...?
Yes!\nYou get it!
A refreshment that outweighs the fatigue...\nthat's the true joy of training!
So,\nround two - let's go!
Huh, we're still going!?
...Hunger?
That one!?\nAhahaha...
But moving around does make you hungry!\nLet's head back\nand eat!
After moving plenty, next is food!\nAnd MORE food!\nEat, eat, eat it all!
(No way no way!! I caaan't!!)
Steamy hot rice! Let's eaaat!!
Toh!
Hah!
Nn...
(...???\nWe've trained how many times now,\nbut something's off about Hibiki today?)
...What's this feeling.\nMy chest is all fuzzy, all tingly...
It's different from what I feel for Miku,\nand it's not Tsubasa or my master either...
I don't get it...\nUugh, I don't get it...!
Um, Hibiki?
...Hweh?
Is this about right?\nI was hoping for some advice.
Got an opening!
Hyau!?\nWh-wh-what!?
(H-huh, it landed that easily?\nThe usual Hibiki would counter right away...)
You startled me...\nWhat's up?
Sorry, that was sudden.\nI just wanted some advice.
Ah, um...?
I-it looks fine?\nWhat do you think?
Asking me...?\nWait, were you even watching?
Th-that's not true?\nI was watching, totally watching!
Lately I've been thinking\nabout you all the time!
I-\nI didn't mean it like that!\nThis is, uh, well...
...Haaa.
(She sighed at me!?)
Rather than teaching,\nI feel like I want to be taught...
Let's call it a day.\nExcuse me...
Wh-what was that,\nHibiki suddenly got all distant...
Maybe she's fed up\n'cause I'm not improving at all...
Too soft!!
Waaah!
No!\nHow many times do I have to tell you!
You're not there! You're really not there!
Like that,\nyou can't protect anyone!
(Hibiki's oddly strict today...!)
This isn't all you've got!\nRemember what you've done!
Draw out your hidden strength! Draw it out!
(D-demon! There's a demon...!!)
If you want to get stronger!\nIf you want the power\nto protect someone!
You have to challenge your limits\nand keep working at it, relentlessly!
I don't want to lose comrades I fight beside.\nThat includes you, of course.
So together,\nlet's aim higher and higher!
...Yes!\nMaster, once more, please!
...Alright!\nNow, on your feet!\nOne more round!!
More!\nMore!\nShow me - get me fired up!
Uoooh...!
That was good... that was really good!
Your will to get stronger\ncame through your fists!
I was just... desperate...\ntotally absorbed.
It's okay, your feelings,\nreached me loud and clear.
...\nFuu.\nGoing all out like that, I feel refreshed too.
When I train with you,\nmy chest gets all warm for some reason...
(Huh? Th-that's...?)
This is that 'friendship'\nborn between people who trade fists!
...Huh?
Actually, I've hardly ever fought\none-on-one, barehanded,\nwith anyone but my master.
There was a boxing movie like that!\nFriendship blooming\nafter a fierce battle!
Didn't you feel it?\nYou felt it, right?
Ah, y-yes...\nI feel it... to the max...
Yayy! I'm so glad we're on the same page!
I see, so this is it!\nAhaha! I'm happy!
(Friendship... very Hibiki, I guess...)
Mikuuuu!!\nI did it!!
